paragraphs.source_en: Lady Chacha instinctively clutched her disheveled garments and sat upright. She seemed ready to resist, but her whole body betrayed an added measure of terror. All at once, she lunged at Hideyoshi.

units.source_en: Lady Chacha instinctively clutched her disheveled garments and sat upright.
units.source_zh: 茶茶姬本能地抓住零乱的衣衫，坐直身子。

units.source_en: She seemed ready to resist, but her whole body betrayed an added measure of terror.

ja.t: おうとしているようだったが、その

units.source_zh: 她似要反抗，但浑身多了几分恐怖。

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶茶姬本能地抓住零乱的衣衫，坐直身子。她似要反抗，但浑身多了几分恐怖。猛然间，她扑向秀吉。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah!” Hideyoshi cried out. For an instant, all the blood in his body seemed to freeze. He had been far too careless. This woman, who had defied Hideyoshi without the slightest restraint, had been driven into a corner and now had no choice but to fight him to the death!

units.source_en: “Ah!”
Hideyoshi cried out.
units.source_zh: 秀吉叫起来。

units.source_en: He had been far too careless.
units.source_zh: 他太大意了。

units.source_en: This woman, who had defied Hideyoshi without the slightest restraint, had been driven into a corner and now had no choice but to fight him to the death!
units.source_zh: 这个肆无忌惮反抗秀吉的女子，被逼得走投无路，只有与他拼个鱼死网破！

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊！”秀吉叫起来。一瞬间，他全身的血液都好像凝固了。他太大意了。这个肆无忌惮反抗秀吉的女子，被逼得走投无路，只有与他拼个鱼死网破！

paragraphs.source_en: Her movements were so swift and deft that they took him utterly by surprise. As she sprang at him, Hideyoshi felt an icy chill as though a blade had pierced his chest.

units.source_en: Her movements were so swift and deft that they took him utterly by surprise.
units.source_zh: 她此时的动作是那般机敏，实出人意料。

units.source_en: As she sprang at him, Hideyoshi felt an icy chill as though a blade had pierced his chest.
units.source_zh: 当她扑过来时，秀吉觉得仿佛有把刀子刺进胸膛般冰冷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 她此时的动作是那般机敏，实出人意料。当她扑过来时，秀吉觉得仿佛有把刀子刺进胸膛般冰冷。

paragraphs.source_en: Is this the end of my life—of Hideyoshi’s life? The thought flashed through his mind like lightning.

units.source_en: Is this the end of my life—of Hideyoshi’s life?
units.source_zh: 我秀吉一生就此完结了？

units.source_en: The thought flashed through his mind like lightning.
units.source_zh: 这个念头如闪电般从他脑海划过。

paragraphs.source_zh: 我秀吉一生就此完结了？这个念头如闪电般从他脑海划过。

paragraphs.source_en: But it was not so. No naked blade entered Hideyoshi’s body. Chacha flung herself into the arms he had instinctively opened, clung to him as if demented, and burst into loud sobs.

units.source_en: But it was not so.

ja.t: だが、そうではなかった。

units.source_zh: 并非如此。

units.source_en: No naked blade entered Hideyoshi’s body. Chacha flung herself into the arms he had instinctively opened, clung to him as if demented, and burst into loud sobs.

ja.t: ったようにしがみつくと、わっと

units.source_zh: 秀吉的身体并没有被白刃刺入，茶茶扑进他自然而然张开的双臂，发狂般地抱住他，哇的一声哭了出来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 并非如此。秀吉的身体并没有被白刃刺入，茶茶扑进他自然而然张开的双臂，发狂般地抱住他，哇的一声哭了出来。

paragraphs.source_en: Startled, Hideyoshi hurriedly looked around. When he had steadied himself, he realized that he truly had not been stabbed; Chacha’s soft body was trembling as it nestled against his meager chest. Hideyoshi was at something of a loss. If she had not meant to kill him, then what was she doing?

units.source_en: Startled, Hideyoshi hurriedly looked around.

units.source_en: When he had steadied himself, he realized that he truly had not been stabbed; Chacha’s soft body was trembling as it nestled against his meager chest.
units.source_zh: 他镇定一下，才发现确实没被刺中，茶茶柔软的身体颤抖着，依偎在他瘦弱的胸前。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi was at something of a loss.
units.source_zh: 秀吉有些不知所措。

units.source_en: If she had not meant to kill him, then what was she doing?

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉一惊，慌忙环顾四周。他镇定一下，才发现确实没被刺中，茶茶柔软的身体颤抖着，依偎在他瘦弱的胸前。秀吉有些不知所措。如她不是想刺杀自己，那是在做什么呢？

paragraphs.source_en: Fear? Seeking comfort? An apology? Trying to ingratiate herself? It seemed to be none of those things. Chacha’s fingernails pressed harder and harder until they dug into Hideyoshi’s flesh. She wept wildly, her cries gradually rising in pitch.

units.source_zh: 茶茶的指甲渐渐加力，嵌入了秀吉的肉里。

paragraphs.source_en: Afraid that Yū might hear and come, Hideyoshi glanced around once more. Chacha clutched him desperately as she wept; hers was grief from the very depths of her heart. Hideyoshi was left almost dazed; this was far beyond anything he had expected.

units.source_en: Afraid that Yū might hear and come, Hideyoshi glanced around once more.
units.source_zh: 秀吉怕有乐闻声前来，再次环视四周。

units.source_en: Chacha clutched him desperately as she wept; hers was grief from the very depths of her heart.
units.source_zh: 茶茶拼命抓着他哭泣，那是发自心底的悲哀。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi was left almost dazed; this was far beyond anything he had expected.

units.source_zh: 秀吉竟有些发懵，这太出乎他的意料了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉怕有乐闻声前来，再次环视四周。茶茶拼命抓着他哭泣，那是发自心底的悲哀。秀吉竟有些发懵，这太出乎他的意料了。

paragraphs.source_en: Could Chacha have found my suspicion too painful to bear? Unable to put her tangled emotions into words, had she thrown herself into my arms to weep? Thinking this, Hideyoshi wrapped his arms tightly around Chacha as well.

units.source_en: Could Chacha have found my suspicion too painful to bear?
units.source_zh: 或是茶茶觉得，我的怀疑让她无法忍受？

units.source_en: Unable to put her tangled emotions into words, had she thrown herself into my arms to weep?

ja.t: にできず、それでわしの

units.source_zh: 她那复杂的感情无以言表，因此扑到我怀中哭泣？

units.source_en: Thinking this, Hideyoshi wrapped his arms tightly around Chacha as well.
units.source_zh: 秀吉这么想着，亦紧紧抱住茶茶。

paragraphs.source_zh: 或是茶茶觉得，我的怀疑让她无法忍受？她那复杂的感情无以言表，因此扑到我怀中哭泣？秀吉这么想着，亦紧紧抱住茶茶。

paragraphs.source_en: At last Lady Chacha stopped crying, but she still clung tightly to Hideyoshi, and salty tears dripped onto the black hair hanging over her breast.

units.source_en: At last Lady Chacha stopped crying, but she still clung tightly to Hideyoshi, and salty tears dripped onto the black hair hanging over her breast.
units.source_zh: 茶茶姬总算停止了哭泣，但还是紧紧抱着秀吉，垂在胸口的黑发也滴上了咸涩的眼泪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶茶姬总算停止了哭泣，但还是紧紧抱着秀吉，垂在胸口的黑发也滴上了咸涩的眼泪。

paragraphs.source_en: “Chacha! I went too far... Forgive me!” Hideyoshi gently smoothed Chacha’s disordered hair, making Lady Chacha begin to sob softly once more. Everything about her revealed a sorrow too painful for her heart to bear.

units.source_en: “Chacha!
units.source_zh: “茶茶！

units.source_en: I went too far... Forgive me!”
units.source_zh: 我太过分了……原谅！”

units.source_en: Hideyoshi gently smoothed Chacha’s disordered hair, making Lady Chacha begin to sob softly once more.
units.source_zh: 秀吉悄悄梳理一下茶茶的乱发，惹得茶茶姬又低声哭泣起来。

units.source_en: Everything about her revealed a sorrow too painful for her heart to bear.
units.source_zh: 这一切无不表明她内心难以忍受的悲哀。

paragraphs.source_zh: “茶茶！我太过分了……原谅！”秀吉悄悄梳理一下茶茶的乱发，惹得茶茶姬又低声哭泣起来。这一切无不表明她内心难以忍受的悲哀。

paragraphs.source_en: “Poor Chacha, an orphan with no one to rely on!” Hideyoshi sighed mournfully. Chacha had grown quiet and nodded again and again, as obediently as an infant.

units.source_en: “Poor Chacha, an orphan with no one to rely on!”
units.source_zh: “可怜的茶茶，无依无靠的孤儿！”

units.source_en: Hideyoshi sighed mournfully.
units.source_zh: 秀吉哀哀叹道。

units.source_en: Chacha had grown quiet and nodded again and again, as obediently as an infant.
units.source_zh: 茶茶已经安静了，像婴儿般听话地频频点头。

paragraphs.source_zh: “可怜的茶茶，无依无靠的孤儿！”秀吉哀哀叹道。茶茶已经安静了，像婴儿般听话地频频点头。

paragraphs.source_en: “There, there! Don’t cry anymore!” Hideyoshi brushed his cheek with her black hair. All at once, he was struck by a startling realization: she was no longer a child!

units.source_en: “There, there!

units.source_en: All at once, he was struck by a startling realization: she was no longer a child!
units.source_zh: 猛然间，他大吃一惊：她不是个孩子了！

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，好！不要再哭了！”秀吉用黑发抚着自己的脸颊。猛然间，他大吃一惊：她不是个孩子了！

paragraphs.source_en: The rigidity of Chacha’s body told Hideyoshi that she was still resisting. She was no little child now, but a beautiful young woman! The moment he realized this and caught the fragrance of a woman’s body, he became utterly flustered.

units.source_en: The rigidity of Chacha’s body told Hideyoshi that she was still resisting.
units.source_zh: 茶茶僵硬的身体，让秀吉感受到她还在抵抗。

units.source_en: She was no little child now, but a beautiful young woman!
units.source_zh: 她已不是小孩子了，是个美貌的姑娘啦！

units.source_en: The moment he realized this and caught the fragrance of a woman’s body, he became utterly flustered.
units.source_zh: 当他意识到这一点，也闻到了女人的体香时，顿时狼狈不堪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶茶僵硬的身体，让秀吉感受到她还在抵抗。她已不是小孩子了，是个美貌的姑娘啦！当他意识到这一点，也闻到了女人的体香时，顿时狼狈不堪。

paragraphs.source_en: Chacha was far more mature than Lady Kaga, upon whom Hideyoshi now lavished his affection. Now her supple limbs clung desperately to him... She was no ordinary woman: proud and uninhibited in her gifts, upright and unyielding, she had scorned every man Hideyoshi thought suitable. What sort of man could be the husband this woman desired?

paragraphs.source_en: At the thought, Hideyoshi suddenly flushed crimson. His heart pounded violently, and Chacha could hear it distinctly.

units.source_en: The daughter of Azai Nagamasa!

units.source_en: The niece of Oda Ufu!
units.source_zh: 织田右府的外甥女！

paragraphs.source_en: Chacha had been born to Lady Odani—Oichi, whom Hideyoshi could never forget and whose very memory made his heart ache. That made his feelings seem deeply improper. Heaven had shown altogether too much favor to the son of a mere peasant from Nakamura in Owari, bestowing upon him this jewel of a woman!

units.source_en: Chacha had been born to Lady Odani—Oichi, whom Hideyoshi could never forget and whose very memory made his heart ache. That made his feelings seem deeply improper.
units.source_zh: 茶茶乃秀吉念念不忘、一想到就心疼不已的小谷夫人——阿市所生，这让秀吉甚感不妥。

units.source_en: Heaven had shown altogether too much favor to the son of a mere peasant from Nakamura in Owari, bestowing upon him this jewel of a woman!
units.source_zh: 上天对尾张中村一介农夫之子过厚了，竟赏给他这个珠玉般的女子！

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶茶乃秀吉念念不忘、一想到就心疼不已的小谷夫人——阿市所生，这让秀吉甚感不妥。上天对尾张中村一介农夫之子过厚了，竟赏给他这个珠玉般的女子！
